value.answer: If you mean soccer, I'd say Messi. Recent rankings put him first, and he's the World Cup's all-time leading scorer with 18 goals. Ronaldo is the main rival, and the debate isn't formally settled. If you mean the NFL, it's usually Tom Brady, though Brady himself says Jerry Rice.
